prompt: Create an original editorial illustration for the Code198x long-form study of Adventure / Colossal Cave, the 1970s text adventure. Wide panoramic full-bleed website masthead, landscape 3:1 composition. A magnificent subterranean limestone cave imagined through words: layered ink-black and petrol teal rock, enormous stalactites, a small warm brass lamp resting on a ledge at the lower right, its amber light revealing turquoise underground water, a narrow winding route disappearing through a distant opening. Subtle fragments of pale green monospaced letterforms dissolve into mineral strata at the far right, suggesting a world summoned by language without readable text. Sophisticated painted print illustration, rich colour, restrained paper texture, cinematic scale and mystery, precise organic silhouettes, 1970s speculative paperback atmosphere without imitating any named artist or existing cover. Main visual interest in right two thirds and lower band. Left third is predominantly deep dark teal negative space with only faint cave contour, to hold large white HTML title. Keep focal lamp and distant opening visible when a narrow mobile crop shows centre-right. Flat image only: no webpage UI, no title, no logos, no people, no dragons, no copied game artwork. Clearly an imaginative illustration rather than a photograph or game screenshot.
